info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Point of Service Management API
info.description: The Point of Service Management API facilitates the updating and modification of point of service information across multiple banking channels. This endpoint allows authorized services to modify existing records by utilizing unique identifiers, enabling seamless data synchronization. Typical consumers include internal banking systems and third-party applications that manage customer transactions at various service points. By ensuring accurate and up-to-date information, the API enhances customer experience and operational efficiency.

patch.summary: Update point of service details for a specific reservation.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific point of service associated with a reservation. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to modify the reservation details effectively.
